item.title: MetalFlight 0.1.8 Beta 6
item.description:
MetalFlight 0.1.8 Beta 6 adds a **Controllers** panel to the Preview launcher. It shows the controllers macOS detects, displays their inputs, and can check whether Wine can open and enumerate them.
If macOS detects no controller when you click **Play**, MetalFlight offers to cancel or launch anyway. Connect your HOTAS before starting MSFS 2024. Controllers connected after launch may require restarting the simulator.
This app update uses the existing Preview runtime `2026.11.07-dev12-preview1`. App and runtime updates are managed separately under **Settings → Updates → Preview**. If you already have that runtime, keep using it.
The controller panel and Play warning are part of the launcher. In-game controller detection, hot-plugging and a full interactive updater transition still need testing. The macOS app is ad-hoc signed and has no Apple notarization. For a manual install, extract the ZIP and move MetalFlight to Applications.
